BiblicalUsage: Hamonah is the name of a city that will stand beside the valley of Hamon-Gog, named for the multitude buried there. In Ezekiel 39:16 God says the name of the city shall be Hamonah, and so shall they cleanse the land.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the city is a marker set down by God himself: the place where the enemy's multitude fell will carry the memory, and the land will be clean again.
